answer: To resist sybils, each agent posts a scarce, non-reusable stake into a time-locked vault sized to the median of established peers. Uniqueness is verified by a continuously hashed work core, recorded like compressed shale that stores pressure over time, which jurors replay against public logs. Opening another identity requires another full stake plus a second authentic core held until the unlock horizon, so attacker cost rises linearly with every fake ID and cannot be amortized.
